data: Apple's fiscal 2023 results showed a modest top-line contraction, with revenue of $383.3 billion against $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022, a decline of 2.8%. Gross profit eased to $169.1 billion in fiscal 2023 from $170.8 billion in fiscal 2022, and the company posted a gross margin of 44.1% in fiscal 2023. Operating income fell to $114.3 billion in fiscal 2023 from $119.4 billion in fiscal 2022, for a fiscal 2023 operating margin of 29.8%. Net income declined 2.8% to $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023 from $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022. Diluted EPS still edged up to $6.13 in fiscal 2023 from $6.11 in fiscal 2022, which suggests a lower share count offset the profit decline. Apple also raised R&D expense to $29.9 billion in fiscal 2023 from $26.3 billion in fiscal 2022, so it kept investing even as sales softened.
